background: Bank of America Corporation is the holding company of the second-largest US bank, spanning consumer banking, wealth management under Merrill and a global corporate and investment bank.
synthesis: Rated A+ on average across all three, the weakest of them at A-, all three on a stable outlook, with no move since a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 3 May 2023. The balance sheet sits on the weak side of US banks: CET1 of 11.2% is in the bottom quarter, and leverage of 5.5% and LCR of 112% are both below the peer median. None of the ratios has moved materially over the past four periods, so the position is steady rather than deteriorating. Flagged news in the last 90 days is share price and litigation noise rather than credit events, the newest on 8 Oct 2026.
